title: Match Maker-GTD immutable timestamps to PostgreSQL midpoint-even microsecond storage
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Correct the verified Maker-GTD atomic-transition timestamp comparison so an original order timestamp and its persisted PostgreSQL timestamptz value compare equal exactly when PostgreSQL stores them in the same microsecond.
inScope: The shared Maker-GTD immutable initial-order timestamp normalizer used for created_at_utc and expires_at_utc comparisons in atomic full-fill, expiry, and already-applied shape checks.
PostgreSQL midpoint-to-even behavior at the exact half-microsecond boundary, including the production shape 2026-08-29T08:09:31.7195025Z persisted as 2026-08-29T08:09:31.719502Z.
Focused regression coverage for even and odd half-microsecond ties, non-tie upward rounding, unchanged exact microseconds, and timestamps that resolve to different PostgreSQL microseconds.
Required focused tests, affected build, requirement validation, independent semantic review, context/history bookkeeping, commit, and push.
outOfScope: Production database mutation, replay or repair of expired order fec9a0b5-bd77-4bcd-ba58-8a34e8899ffa, deployment, service restart, configuration change, strategy mutation, order submission, cancellation, or any Live action.

Any change to Maker-GTD strategy selection, Reference Average signal logic, price, tick rounding, size, PostOnly/GTD intent, TouchNoDepth evidence, acceptance, fill, expiry, continuity, deadline, accounting, or Paper/Live classification.
Any relaxation of non-timestamp immutable fields, lifecycle state, execution source, order/run linkage, position concurrency, atomicity, or idempotency guards.

Slow market-data side-effect queues, CLOB 404 responses, historical Gross/Net parity, Legacy backfill, Dashboard behavior, and unrelated timestamps that do not use the initial-order PostgreSQL JSONB-recordset persistence path.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact Maker-GTD Paper atomic transitions; production evidence is the exact order fec9a0b5-bd77-4bcd-ba58-8a34e8899ffa and timestamps observed on 2026-08-29 UTC.
scope.firstVerification: Use a bounded Production BEGIN READ ONLY session with statement_timeout=15s and UTC to verify the exact order and the PostgreSQL jsonb_to_recordset conversion of .7195025 to the stored .719502 microsecond before editing code.

requirements.text: Implement the authorized Maker-GTD timestamp-equivalence correction using PostgreSQL's actual midpoint-to-even microsecond storage behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The production shape 2026-08-29T08:09:31.7195025Z compares equal to persisted 2026-08-29T08:09:31.719502Z.
An odd lower microsecond half-tie such as 2026-08-29T08:09:31.7195035Z compares equal to persisted 2026-08-29T08:09:31.719504Z.
Existing non-tie upward-rounding shapes remain equivalent to their PostgreSQL values.
Timestamps that PostgreSQL stores in different microseconds remain unequal and continue to produce the existing shape-mismatch reason and diagnostic.
The same storage-precision rule applies consistently to the shared created_at_utc and expires_at_utc immutable initial-order checks.

verification.command: dotnet test tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter MakerGtdPaperAtomicRepositoryTests|MakerGtdPaperLifecycleIntegrationTests with TEMP/TMP and all disposable outputs under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run
verification.expected: The exact production regression, even/odd midpoint ties, non-tie rounding, distinct-microsecond rejection, full-fill, expiry, idempotency and lifecycle checks pass.

requirements.text: Keep every non-timestamp Maker-GTD execution and persistence rule unchanged and make no Production/runtime change in this implementation task.
acceptanceCriteria: No strategy, price, size, intent, evidence, lifecycle, accounting, classification, Live, database schema, configuration, deployment, service, or Production data behavior changes except the exact immutable timestamp equivalence described by REQ-001.
The mandatory label remains optimistic TouchNoDepth Paper; not Live-equivalent; may overstate fills.
The affected Release build passes, git diff --check passes, requirement validation passes, and an independent reviewer finds no scope or semantic deviation.

verification.command: dotnet build PolyCopyTrader.sln -c Release --no-restore with TEMP/TMP and disposable outputs under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run; git diff --check; requirement validation in WorkingTree and Staged modes; independent semantic review
verification.expected: The approved timestamp-only diff builds and all scope, traceability, parity-label, and review gates pass without Production mutation.
